description: Frozen catalog known-answer queries for qmd's unchanged native bench. Explicit lexical/vector query documents avoid automatic expansion. Expected URIs retain collections for separate exact-identity verification; the upstream scorer itself strips collections and accepts suffix matches. Search all four catalog collections. Compare live 0.6B and separate 8B indexes.

lex: foundation trading shared hot files

lex: token counters cumulative overlapping

lex: qmd catalog collections native retrieval

lex: north star historical simulation broker paper
